en.p: For three constants $a$, $b$, $c$, the function $f(x)=ae^{2x}+be^{x}+c$ satisfies the following conditions.
When $g(x)$ is the inverse function of $f(x)$, $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{14}g(x)\,dx=p+q\ln 2$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$, $q$ are rational numbers, and $\ln 2$ is irrational.) [4 points]
